name: 479. xAI batch and files on an xai-based custom provider reach the paths its request_path_overrides name (xai path overrides) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7084 regression, contract C3, C8, C12. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream (providerErrorFixtureUrl when it is not on http://127.0.0.1:8791). Every row is skipped otherwise. tkp_xaicompat is an xai-based custom provider for a vendor that serves xAI's batch and file API under /api/v2 instead of /v1: allowed_requests batch_* and file_*, one named key enabled for batches, and request_path_overrides for every batch and file request type. For a call that names a batch or a file the override is a template: {batch_id} or {file_id} is where the id goes (batch_cancel /api/v2/batches/{batch_id}:cancel, file_content /api/v2/files/{file_id}/content). xAI creates an inline batch in two calls; the second, POST {batch}/requests, names the batch the first created, so it follows the batch_create override with /{batch_id}/requests appended. Before the change every xAI batch and file call went to xAI's own /v1 path whatever the overrides said. The fixture answers only under /pp/xaicompat/api/v2, so a call on a default path is a 404 and fails its row, and GET /__wire returns each call with the name of the key it carried. Rows: (1) an inline batch is created at /api/v2/batches and its line added at /api/v2/batches/{id}/requests; (2) list, (3) retrieve, (4) results and (5) cancel reach /api/v2/batches and /api/v2/batches/{id}[/results|:cancel]; (6) upload, (7) list, (8) retrieve, (9) content and (10) delete reach /api/v2/files and /api/v2/files/{id}[/content]; (11) writing an xai-based provider whose batch_cancel override has no {batch_id} is refused. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: [EXPECT-400] POST /api/providers: an xai-based provider whose batch_cancel override has no {batch_id} is refused when it is written (xai path overrides)

exec: pm.test('xai path overrides setup: the fixture was reset', function () {

pm.test('the provider is refused with a 400 naming the override and its placeholder', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + pm.response.text()).to.equal(400); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('request_path_overrides.batch_cancel'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('{batch_id}'); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/providers/harness-xaicompat-no-placeholder', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('nothing was stored', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code, res.text()).to.equal(404); }); });
